item.title: Mistral AI Opens Asia-Pacific HQ in Singapore to Build Custom Government Models
item.description:
Mistral AI announced an Asia-Pacific headquarters in Singapore, planning to grow regional headcount beyond 200 by 2027, operating as an 'extended science center' building custom sovereign AI models for government agencies and industrial clients. The move extends its work with Singapore's HTX on the Phoenix sovereign LLM project, targeting public sector, high-tech manufacturing and robotics.

item.title: China Meteorological Administration and Shanghai AI Lab Launch Earth-System Research Agent Platform
item.description:
The China Meteorological Administration and Shanghai AI Laboratory jointly launched ZHU·GE, an earth-system intelligent research platform whose scientific agents autonomously handle literature retrieval, data access, coding, experimentation and result analysis to advance AI4S in geoscience. The platform already aggregates roughly 10PB of public scientific data, 1PB of CMA-authorized data, 2 million literature records and over 5,000 code tools, with plans to cover meteorological research units and open to alliance universities.

原文标题：中国气象局与上海 AI 实验室推出地球系统科研智能体平台

item.title: XiaZibian Releases WALL-OSS-1.0 Embodied Foundation Model
item.description:
Chinese embodied AI startup XiaZibian released WALL-OSS-1.0, a new embodied foundation model that treats pretraining itself as the source of intelligence rather than a starting point for task fine-tuning. Training runs in two stages: action data is injected early alongside multimodal data so world understanding and manipulation form in one set of weights, then an action expert is added for precise, efficient motion generation. The model ranks first among single models on the RoboDojo simulation leaderboard and reaches 55.1% zero-shot success on real robots.

原文标题：自变量发布具身基础模型 WALL-OSS-1.0

Why it matters：具身基础模型以预训练为核心范式，并在仿真榜单与真机零样本上给出可验证结果，值得关注。

item.title: MBK Partners to Take Wacom Private in $390 Million Deal
item.description:
South Korean private equity firm MBK Partners plans to take Japanese digital pen and tablet maker Wacom private via a tender offer at ¥1,030 per share, valuing the company at roughly ¥139.05 billion (about RMB 5.85 billion), with the offer expected to launch in February 2027. Samsung Electronics and Wacom CEO Nobutaka Ide intend to roll their proceeds into the acquirer's parent company to retain stakes, with Ide staying on after the deal.

item.title: AI Bots Now Supply 52% of Helpful Community Notes on X
item.description:
A SpaceXAI paper reports that after X opened a public API for Community Notes, AI bots can draft candidate notes, with the largest bot Community Writer using two Grok models to draft, filter weak submissions, and delete notes flagged by early ratings. In June 2026 it produced 41% of proposed notes and 52% of helpful ones while consuming only 22% of human ratings. Every note still requires human raters to decide display, and 42% of posts with a helpful note had only AI notes.

原文标题：AI 机器人贡献 X 社区笔记 52% 有用内容

Why it matters：首次以量化数据揭示 AI 智能体在真实内容审核平台上的规模化协作效果与人工评分节省。

item.title: Just How Large Is a 17 Million Line Lean Proof
item.description:
Responding to claims that a Riemann hypothesis proof spans 17 million lines of Lean, the author benchmarks that figure against 259 famous theorems in Mathlib and every Lean package indexed on Reservoir. The comparison shows the claim is genuinely extreme: all of Mathlib is about 2.4 million lines and only three packages exceed 17 million, underscoring the scale of machine-checkable formal proofs.

原文标题：1700 万行 Lean 证明规模究竟有多大

Why it matters：以实证数据回答形式化数学证明规模问题，为关注 AI for Math 与 Lean 生态的读者提供有价值的量级参照。

item.title: Ant Group Open-Sources LingSante Medical Model Family Up to 560B
item.description:

item.title: XNU Linux Runs Full macOS GUI Userspace on Linux Kernel
item.description:
The open-source xnulinux project builds Apple's open-source XNU kernel as a loadable module, xnu.ko, and runs it inside an unmodified arm64 Linux kernel. The hosted XNU drives the CPU and MMU directly, so macOS processes run natively alongside Linux processes on the same CPUs with no hypervisor in between. Loading the module on a stock Ubuntu kernel boots a macOS 27 system disk created by Apple's own installer all the way to the desktop, including loginwindow, WindowServer, Dock, Finder, Safari and Chrome.

原文标题：XNU Linux 让 macOS 图形界面跑在 Linux 内核上

Why it matters：以无虚拟化方式在 Linux 内核内托管 XNU 并跑通完整 macOS 图形桌面，是操作系统架构层面罕见且极具讨论价值的工程突破。

item.title: Storage Economics Emerge as Key Constraint for China's AI Scale-Up
item.description:
As China's AI shifts from model training to production-scale inference, inference data volume surpassed training data for the first time in 2025, with total data volume and retention periods rising in tandem, making storage economics a core infrastructure variable. Citing IDC research, Western Digital notes that nearly 95% of organizations say AI has increased the value of their data, but balancing capacity, performance and long-term cost is what underpins scale deployment.

原文标题：推理数据首超训练，存储经济性成中国 AI 规模化关键

Why it matters：以推理数据首超训练这一结构性拐点切入，提供了中国 AI 数据规模与存储成本压力的量化视角，但整体为厂商赞助内容，技术增量有限。

item.title: RoboChallenge Zero Debuts Real-Robot Benchmark for 11 Multimodal Models
item.description:
RoboChallenge released RoboChallenge Zero, a real-robot zero-shot benchmark that plugged 11 multimodal large models into a unified control interface across two robot platforms, running 330 trials on six tasks. Overall success rate was 44.85%, with the best model at 70%; coarse pick-and-place was reliable, while deformable-object and long-horizon tasks nearly all failed, and successful runs averaged over 13 minutes, showing general models remain far from reliable, efficient physical manipulation.

原文标题：RoboChallenge Zero 首测 11 个大模型真机成功率 44.85%

Why it matters：首个以真机零样本方式横向评测多模态大模型具身能力的公开基准，数据扎实且对具身智能路线判断有直接参考价值。
